functionalReqs: N×N board, two players with symbols
Players take turns; invalid moves rejected
Detect win (row, column, diagonal) and draw
hints: Which classes: Game, Board, Cell, Player, Move?
To check a win in O(1), keep counters per row, column and diagonal for each player.

Game orchestrates turns; Board owns the cells and validation; Player is an interface with HumanPlayer and BotPlayer (Strategy for move choice); WinningStrategy keeps row/col/diag counters; undo via a stack of Moves (Command pattern).
nonFunctionalReqs: Win check in O(1) per move
New player types (e.g., AI with different difficulty) plug in easily
problemStatement:
Design an **N×N Tic-Tac-Toe** game for two players (human or computer).

The design should detect wins in O(1) per move and allow different board sizes and player types.
title: Design Tic-Tac-Toe
